status: declared by the pull request that closes #850 before any score; step 2 of H9, a measurement on development data, not a record and not a verdict (scoring protocol v1 section 1). Nothing is published: richer_targets.b1_quantiles, the protocol's benchmarks and every published figure are unchanged, no day after 2025-12-31 is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md) and no hindsight regime label is used (ruling on #515). None of the intervals is corrected for multiplicity

panel.built_by: scripts/richer_targets_639.py panel over measurement_fields.py's scratch panel and early_warning_inputs.py's (the panel of step 1, metadata/richer_targets_639.json)

targets.definition: ON RRP take-up, the day's total accepted
ON RRP take-up, change from the previous panel day
standing repo facility take-up, the day's total accepted

days: the scored days of the lead-1 fold grid, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31, the same days at every lead

arms.h: richer_targets.b1_quantiles at lead h: the last public value plus the empirical distribution of the h-row changes over the trailing two years
arms.h1: the same function called with h + 1: the (h + 1)-row changes over the same window and the same anchor
arms.dropped: a day on which either arm, B2 or the outcome is missing is dropped for both arms

benchmark_b2: richer_targets.b2_quantiles: the trailing year's values on days of the scored day's reporting day type

metrics.coverage: share of days on which the outcome lies between the forecast's 0.05 and 0.95 quantiles, both included
metrics.crps: scoring_protocol.grid_crps on the protocol's 23 quantile levels, mean over days, in the target's unit
metrics.ranking: B1 if its mean CRPS is below B2's, B2 if above; a flip is a cell where the two arms rank differently

interval: metrics.stationary_bootstrap_interval, mean block 10, 2000 resamples, seed 850, two-sided 90%; the same resamples for every statistic of a cell

splits.regime: the as-of scarcity state at the same lead: ample (0, 1), scarce (2, 3)

control: on step 1's day set (arm h and B2 only) arm h reproduces docs/pivot/evidence/richer-targets-639/screen.json at its leads
gap: the share of scored days on which the as-of anchor is h, h + 1 or another number of panel days before the scored day
not_run: no model, no change to any benchmark, no ruling; a flip is a marked question for Eleonora
